item_verdicts.manifest: The source manifest reports status complete, three commits, three changed paths, an after arm of 77 passed EXIT=0 and a baseline of 72 passed with 2 errors it attributes to a git-less extraction; each named log exists on disk and holds the stated result.

justifications.durability: The cold-import guard still fails on its regression (negative-control.log records EXIT=1 with report['before'] holding reckon._store and reckon._worker_fence), but the increment weakened the initialize test at tests/test_anchored_edit.py:441 by comparing serverInfo.name with the constant reckon/anchored_edit.py:555 uses to build that field.
justifications.evidence: Every done-when item is on disk and read: initialize-timings.log records 3.035-7.322 s before and 0.233-0.317 s after (EXIT=0), clive-session-stream.jsonl records status connected with both tools at 568b3c85, after-suite.log records 77 passed EXIT=0 at the head, and ruff passes on the head files; the clive arm predates the head, which tests/test_anchored_edit.py:396 covers by driving the console script through the real MCP client at the head.
justifications.fit: Removing build_server leaves one declaration of the served tool surface in reckon/anchored_edit.py, beside _TOOLS at :455, and the file stays ruff-clean at the head.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The increment deletes the only remaining framework-registered definition in reckon/anchored_edit.py (build_server, removed in 81319b7), leaving :596 serve() as the sole server path, so the cold-start answers the goal measures come from one implementation and no runtime behaviour changed.
justifications.reuse: The increment adds no definition; it removes a duplicate of the capability serve() already provides, and git grep jsonrpc over reckon/ finds no other JSON-RPC serving loop that either could have been extended.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 568b3c85..558feb5baa is confined to reckon/anchored_edit.py, tests/test_anchored_edit.py and the declared landing fragment, and the only module change is the deletion of dead code.
